title: 第21章 第一堂符篆课第22章 小白老师
lines: 第21章第一堂符篆课
缩在那装死的孙岳峰心情更加愉悦起来，他忽然有点喜欢这个特别帅的学生了。
孙岳琳则是笑容僵住，看着白牧野：“能告诉我原因吗？”
“我要做符篆师。”白牧野认真回答道。
“就凭你二十点精神力？”装了一会温柔淑女的孙岳琳有点装不下去了，虽然这个男孩子真的很帅，但这时候也顾不得了。
“是啊，但我已经顺利的被一中录取了呀。”白牧野一脸坦然的点点头。
孙岳琳狠狠瞪了一眼孙岳峰。
孙岳峰：？？？
孙岳琳深吸了一口气，尽量让自己的语气柔和点。
“白牧野同学，你听我说。”
“嗯，我听着呢，但我不会去你那的。”白牧野说道。
那边的孙岳峰差点笑出声来。
哈哈哈哈哈！
孙岳琳啊孙岳琳，大魔王是吧？让你欺负我！让你整天在我面前耀武扬威！
怎么样？
现在终于碰钉子了吧？
小白同学，真是好样的！
回头我一定再叮嘱一下庞老师，让他坚决不许再找你麻烦，哈哈哈哈！
孙岳琳看着白牧野，认真的说道：“你听我说完，再决定去不去。”
“您说吧，反正我不去。”白牧野微笑道。
控制怒火！控制怒火！控制怒火！
孙岳琳，你可以的！
这孩子长得这么帅，哪怕说些过分的话，也一定是可以被原谅的！
对，就是这样！
“嗯，没关系，我慢慢跟你说。”孙岳琳语气变得柔和起来。
那边的孙岳峰眼睛瞪大，如同看见了最不可思议的事情。
嚯！
这还是大魔王吗？
有生以来头一遭啊！
“首先呢，姐姐保证，绝对绝对……没有看不起你的意思，你明白吧？”
“你呢，精神力只有二十点，未来注定了不可能有太大的发展，这个你认同吧？”
白牧野摇摇头：“不认同，我很厉害的。”
孙岳琳微笑看着白牧野。
你长得好看，说什么过分的话都没关系！
“你不认同没关系，但事实如此。如果你想看例子，我可以给你举出一堆。”
孙岳琳一挥手，办公室出现了一道巨大的光幕，那上出现一个个身份信息。
“你看看这些人，全都是高中之前精神力不到三十点的，他们现在有的四五十岁，有的七八十岁，精神力却都没能过百。”
孙岳琳将光幕收回，一脸诚恳的看着白牧野：“人生苦短，但岁月漫长，难道你真的想这样蹉跎一生么？活到一百岁可能还是个初级符篆师，最多中级，这种日子，有意义么？”
“那样的话，的确没意义。”白牧野点点头，表示认同。
孙岳琳顿时芳心大悦，看着白牧野的眼神愈发柔和。
content_en:
Chapter 21 The first talisman lesson
Sun Yuefeng, who was cowering there and pretending to be dead, felt even happier. He suddenly liked this particularly handsome student.
Sun Yuelin's smile froze and she looked at Bai Muye: "Can you tell me the reason?"
"I want to be a talisman seal master." Bai Muye replied seriously.
"Just because you have 20 points of mental power?" Sun Yuelin, who had been pretending to be a gentle lady for a while, could no longer pretend. Although this boy was really handsome, she couldn't care less at this time.
"Yes, but I have been successfully admitted to No. 1 Middle School." Bai Muye nodded calmly.
Sun Yuelin glared at Sun Yuefeng fiercely.
Sun Yuefeng:? ? ?
Sun Yuelin took a deep breath and tried to make her tone softer.
"Classmate Bai Muye, listen to me."
"Well, I'm listening, but I won't go to your place." Bai Muye said.
Sun Yuelin: "..."
Sun Yuefeng over there almost laughed out loud.
Hahahahaha!
Sun Yuelin, Sun Yuelin, the big devil, right? Let you bully me! Let you show off your power in front of me all day long!
How about it?
Now we finally hit a wall, right?
Classmate Xiaobai, that’s great!
I will definitely tell Teacher Pang again later and tell him not to cause trouble to you again, hahahaha!
Sun Yuelin looked at Bai Muye and said seriously: "Listen to what I have to say and then decide whether to go or not."
"You tell me, I won't go anyway." Bai Muye said with a smile.
Control your anger! Control your anger! Control your anger!
Sun Yuelin, you can do it!
This kid is so handsome, even if he says something outrageous, he must be forgiven!
Yes, that’s it!
"Well, it doesn't matter. I'll tell you slowly." Sun Yuelin's tone softened.
Sun Yuefeng's eyes widened over there, as if he had seen the most incredible thing.
Oops!
Is this still the big devil?
This is the first time in my life!
"First of all, sister promises, absolutely absolutely... I don't mean to look down on you, do you understand?"
"As for you, you only have 20 points of mental power, so you are destined not to have much development in the future. Do you agree with this?"
Bai Muye shook his head: "I don't agree, I'm very powerful."
Sun Yuelin looked at Bai Muye with a smile.
You are good-looking, and it doesn’t matter what you say that’s too outrageous!
"It's okay if you don't agree, but it's true. If you want to see examples, I can give you a bunch of them."
Sun Yuelin waved her hand, and a huge light curtain appeared in the office, with identity information appearing on it.
"Look at these people. They all had less than 30 points of mental power before high school. Some of them are now in their forties or fifties, some are in their seventies or eighties, but none of them have more than 100 mental powers."
Sun Yuelin retracted the light screen and looked at Bai Muye with a sincere face: "Life is short, but the years are long. Do you really want to waste your life like this? If you live to be a hundred years old, you may still be a junior talisman seal master, or at most an intermediate level. Is this kind of life meaningful?"
"In that case, it is indeed meaningless." Bai Muye nodded in agreement.
Sun Yuelin was immediately delighted, and her eyes became softer when she looked at Bai Muye.
